accessibility.name: The same list, fitted to the screen

texts: The same list, fitted to the screen
A fixed sidebar on a desktop, a compact header with a menu on a phone. Home, Statistics and Settings are always one tap away.
The sidebar holds the navigation on a wide screen. It folds into a compact header and a menu button on a phone, so the same list fits without any sideways scrolling.
Fixed on the left. Cards sit in columns.
Navigation holds. Cards wrap into fewer columns.
App name and a menu button. Cards stack, one column.
Buttons and checkboxes stay at least 44 pixels tall, and no screen scrolls sideways at any width.
Home is selected first. Reaching Statistics or Settings is one menu choice away, and the chosen screen closes the menu.
